reader.requirement: At --std 85 the declarative USE BEFORE REPORTING identifier-1 (with the Inter-Program Communication module's optional GLOBAL, §1985:X.5.6.2) must be accepted with USE, BEFORE and REPORTING all required and exactly one identifier-1 that references a report group (an 01 entry of the report section, optionally qualified by its report-name), and must refuse any other operand or word sequence.

reader.notes: The REPORTING alternative of useStatement is USE GLOBAL? BEFORE REPORTING reportGroupReference, resolved through ReportGroupResolution as GENERATE's operand is; the same code runs at every edition. GLOBAL is the 1985 IPC module's own format, so admitting it at 85 is correct.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-004/use at --std 85: v01 WORKING-STORAGE 01 DA PIC X. beside RD R-1's 01 DA TYPE DE, declarative 'USE BEFORE REPORTING DA.' (unqualified) -> compiled and RAN ('BEFORE BEFORE END'): the nonunique identifier-1 is accepted unqualified, against cite.py 'OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 (4.3.8.1 Qualification) ... SRL2.1' for 'For each nonunique user-defined name that is explicitly referenced, uniqueness must be established through a sequence of qualifiers which precludes any ambiguity of reference' (and IV.4.3.8.1 SR1 'No other name has the identical spelling and hyphenation'); the same ReportGroupResolution.cs#Resolve funnel as GENERATE, which collects candidates only from report groups.
